Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew, Plants of the World Online: Phalaenopsis
RHS: how to grow Phalaenopsis (moth orchids)

tr.description: Orkide (Phalaenopsis) bakımı: parlak dolaylı ışık, kabuk harcı, ıslat-süzdür sulama, yeniden çiçek için ipuçları ve ASPCA kaydı.
tr.imageAlt: Dışarıda bir ağaçta fotoğraflanmış, sarı işaretli dudaklı beyaz kelebek orkide çiçekleri
tr.caption: Fotoğraf: Phalaenopsis amabilis, Tom Heijnen, iNaturalist üzerinden, CC BY 4.0. Yeniden boyutlandırıldı.

atAGlance.light: Parlak dolaylı ışık; yaz güneşi doğrudan vurmasın
atAGlance.watering: Kabuk kurumaya başlayınca sula; tamamen süzdür, asla suda bekletme
atAGlance.petSafety: ASPCA kedi ve köpekler için toksik değil olarak listeler

en.description: Moth orchid care: bright indirect light, bark mix, soak-and-drain watering, rebloom cues and its ASPCA non-toxic listing.
en.imageAlt: White moth orchid flowers with yellow-marked lips, photographed in a tree outdoors
en.caption: Photo: Phalaenopsis amabilis by Tom Heijnen, via iNaturalist, CC BY 4.0. Resized.

atAGlance.light: Bright indirect light; keep out of direct summer sun
atAGlance.watering: Water when the bark is starting to dry; drain fully and never leave it standing in water
atAGlance.petSafety: Listed as non-toxic to cats and dogs by the ASPCA

es.description: Cuidados de la orquídea mariposa: luz indirecta brillante, corteza, riego por inmersión y drenaje, pistas para refloración y estado según la ASPCA.
es.imageAlt: Flores blancas de orquídea mariposa con labelo marcado de amarillo, fotografiadas en un árbol al aire libre
es.caption: Foto: Phalaenopsis amabilis de Tom Heijnen, vía iNaturalist, CC BY 4.0. Redimensionada.

atAGlance.light: Luz indirecta brillante; sin sol directo en verano
atAGlance.watering: Riega cuando la corteza empiece a secarse; escurre bien y nunca la dejes en agua
atAGlance.petSafety: La ASPCA la incluye como no tóxica para gatos y perros

de.description: Schmetterlingsorchidee pflegen: helles indirektes Licht, Rindensubstrat, tauchen und abtropfen lassen, neue Blütenrispen und ASPCA-Einstufung.
de.imageAlt: Weiße Schmetterlingsorchideen mit gelb gezeichneter Lippe, im Freien an einem Baum fotografiert
de.caption: Foto: Phalaenopsis amabilis von Tom Heijnen, über iNaturalist, CC BY 4.0. Verkleinert.

atAGlance.light: Hell und indirekt; im Sommer keine direkte Sonne
atAGlance.watering: Gießen, wenn die Rinde abzutrocknen beginnt; gut abtropfen lassen, nie im Wasser stehen lassen
atAGlance.petSafety: Von der ASPCA als ungiftig für Katzen und Hunde geführt

pt.description: Cuidados com a orquídea-borboleta: luz indireta clara, casca de pinus, rega com drenagem total, dicas para refloração e a classificação da ASPCA.
pt.imageAlt: Flores brancas de orquídea-borboleta com labelo marcado de amarelo, fotografadas em uma árvore ao ar livre
pt.caption: Foto: Phalaenopsis amabilis de Tom Heijnen, via iNaturalist, CC BY 4.0. Redimensionada.

atAGlance.light: Luz indireta clara; sem sol direto no verão
atAGlance.watering: Regue quando a casca começar a secar; escorra bem e nunca deixe na água
atAGlance.petSafety: A ASPCA lista como não tóxica para gatos e cães

fr.description: Entretien de l’orchidée papillon : lumière vive indirecte, écorce, trempage puis égouttage, conseils de refloraison et classement ASPCA.
fr.imageAlt: Fleurs blanches d’orchidée papillon au labelle marqué de jaune, photographiées dans un arbre en extérieur
fr.caption: Photo : Phalaenopsis amabilis de Tom Heijnen, via iNaturalist, CC BY 4.0. Redimensionnée.

atAGlance.light: Lumière vive indirecte ; pas de soleil direct en été
atAGlance.watering: Arroser quand l’écorce commence à sécher ; bien égoutter, jamais d’eau stagnante
atAGlance.petSafety: Classée non toxique pour les chats et les chiens par l’ASPCA

ja.description: コチョウランの育て方。明るい間接光、樹皮の培地、吸水後の排水、再び咲かせる手がかりと、ASPCAの無毒の掲載を紹介します。
ja.imageAlt: 屋外の木に咲く、唇弁に黄色い模様がある白いコチョウランの花
ja.caption: 写真：Phalaenopsis amabilis、撮影：Tom Heijnen。iNaturalistより、CC BY 4.0。サイズ変更済み。

atAGlance.light: 明るい間接光。夏の直射日光を避ける
atAGlance.watering: 樹皮が乾き始めたら与え、十分に水を切る。水につけたままにしない
atAGlance.petSafety: ASPCAは猫・犬に無毒と掲載
atAGlance.careLevel: ある程度の注意が必要

ko.description: 호접란 관리: 밝은 간접광, 수피 배양토, 담갔다 물 빼기, 재개화 조건과 ASPCA의 무독성 분류를 알아보세요.
ko.imageAlt: 야외 나무에서 촬영한 흰 호접란 꽃. 입술꽃잎에 노란 무늬가 있습니다
ko.caption: 사진: Phalaenopsis amabilis — 촬영: Tom Heijnen, iNaturalist 제공, CC BY 4.0. 크기를 조정했습니다.

atAGlance.watering: 수피가 마르기 시작할 때 물을 주고 완전히 빼세요. 물에 담긴 채 두지 마세요
atAGlance.petSafety: ASPCA가 고양이와 개에게 무독성인 식물로 분류했습니다

it.imageAlt: Fiori bianchi di Phalaenopsis con labello segnato di giallo, fotografati su un albero all’aperto
it.caption: Foto: Phalaenopsis amabilis di Tom Heijnen, tramite iNaturalist, CC BY 4.0. Ridimensionata.

atAGlance.light: Luce intensa indiretta; evita il sole diretto estivo
atAGlance.watering: Annaffia quando la corteccia comincia ad asciugarsi; scola bene, senza ristagni
atAGlance.humidity: Elevata; un vassoio ampio di ghiaia umida può aiutare
atAGlance.petSafety: Non tossica per cani e gatti secondo ASPCA

it.description: Cura della Phalaenopsis: luce indiretta, corteccia drenante, radici e fioritura. Come annaffiare, concimare e controllare umidità e temperatura.

zh-Hant.imageAlt: 戶外樹上的白色蝴蝶蘭花，唇瓣帶黃色斑紋
zh-Hant.caption: 照片： Phalaenopsis amabilis，攝影：Tom Heijnen，來源：iNaturalist， CC BY 4.0. 已調整尺寸。

atAGlance.light: 明亮間接光；避免夏季直射日光
atAGlance.watering: 樹皮開始乾再澆，徹底瀝乾，不可長期泡水

zh-Hant.description: 蝴蝶蘭照護指南：樹皮介質、根色與澆水檢查、光照溫度、促花和施肥，並說明氣生根與寵物無毒分類。
